changelog:
# Lucky v1.0.1

Okay, so remember when I said I rushed v1.0.0? This is me catching up. A lot of what I wanted in the first release is finally here, along with a much better Motion interpolation engine. Thank you all for trying Lucky out!

---

## What's New

### Open with Lucky

- Other apps can now send a video to Lucky with **Open with** or the share sheet.
- If the video is already in your library, Lucky plays that copy, so your resume point and settings carry over, and the rest of the folder becomes the queue.
- Closing the player takes you back to the app that opened it.

### Video Actions

- Long-press any video in the library, carousels, or search to **Play**, **Share**, **Rename**, **Delete**, see its **Properties**, **Mark as watched** or **Mark as unwatched**, or **Remove from history**.
- **Properties** shows the file name, folder, size, date modified, duration, format, bitrate, and the codec, channels, sample rate, language, and bit depth of each track.
- Rename and delete use the system confirmation on Android 10 and later, ask for storage permission on Android 8 and 9, and also work with folders you picked yourself.

### Play in the Background

- New **Play in the background** setting in Settings › Player keeps the sound going when you leave Lucky or turn off the screen.
- You get a media notification with lock screen controls, headset buttons, and a seek bar, and the queue keeps moving to the next video in the background.
- New **Play in background** quick button sends Lucky to the background right away while the video keeps playing, even if the setting is off.

### Mini-player

- With background play on, pressing back while a video is playing shrinks the player into a bar above the bottom navigation instead of closing it.
- The bar shows the thumbnail, title, time, and progress, with play and pause and a stop button. Tap it to open the full player again.

### Audio Only

- New **Audio only** option in the player settings hides the picture and keeps the sound playing on a black screen, which saves battery.
- It stays on for the next videos in the queue until you turn it off.

### Player Look

The player controls got a whole new look, and there's a new **Player look** page in Settings › Player with a live preview you can tap and drag to try everything out.

- Glass button groups, a play button that morphs between play and pause with an accent glow, press animations, and a seek bar that grows while you drag it.
- **Control layout** can be Centered or Docked.
- **Button style** can be Plain, Bubbles, or Glass.
- **Play button** can be Rounded, Circle, Ring, or Icon only.
- **Show and hide animation** can be Slide, Fade, or Pop.
- **Time display** can be Both sides, Together, or Above.
- **Background shade** darkens the top and bottom of the video while the controls are showing, so they're easier to read. It can be None, Light, Medium, or Strong.
- **Accent glow** adds a soft glow around the play button.
- Two new seek bar styles: **Capsule** and **Glow**.
- Quick buttons can now be reordered, and top bar buttons can be hidden.
- **Reset look** brings back Lucky's default player look.

### Side Panel

- Player settings is now a compact panel with **Playback**, **Picture**, and **Quality** tabs instead of a full-width sheet. It docks to the right in landscape and on large screens, and sits in the lower half on phones in portrait, so the video stays visible.
- Subtitles, audio, speed, equalizer, and chapters open in the same panel too.
- Drag the edge of the panel to make it wider or narrower in landscape, or the top handle to make it taller or shorter in portrait. Lucky remembers the size.
- New pin button keeps the panel open. Taps on the video still go to the player, so the controls and gestures keep working while you adjust things live.

### Volume and Brightness

- New volume panel on the right side of the player that shows up when you swipe or press the volume keys.
- Keep pressing volume up, or keep swiping up, past 100% to boost the volume up to 300%. The panel shows a **Boost** badge while it's on.
- **Remember volume** in Settings › Player brings back the volume and boost you used last time. It's on by default.
- Brightness now shows up in a matching panel on the left side.

### Skip Intro, Recap, and Credits

- When a chapter is named like an intro, opening, recap, or end credits, a **Skip intro**, **Skip recap**, or **Skip credits** button shows up in the bottom corner.
- It jumps to the next chapter, or to the next video in the queue when the credits run to the end.
- Chapter names are matched in several languages, and long chapters that only look like an intro are ignored.

### Shows and Episodes

- Episodes of the same show now share the audio track, subtitle track, and subtitle and audio delays. Pick Hindi audio, English subtitles, or fix the sync in one episode, and the next one starts the same way.
- Zoom, position, aspect ratio, video size, rotation, and mirror carry over to the next episode too.
- A video's own saved choices still come first, and clearing watch history clears these as well.
- **Continue watching** now keeps one card per show: the episode you're in the middle of, or the next one you haven't watched, labeled **Next episode**. Playing a show from there queues its episodes in order.
- Finished videos get a check mark on their thumbnail instead of a full progress bar.

### Resume and Zoom

- When a video picks up where you left off, a small **Resumed from** notice shows up in the bottom corner for a few seconds, with a **Start over** button that jumps back to the beginning.
- After pinching to zoom or move the video, a **Reset zoom** button shows up under the zoom level for a few seconds.

### Battery Indicator

- The battery next to the clock in the player now shows when it's charging, fully charged, low, critical, or on battery saver, with green, amber, orange, and red colors to match.

---

## Improvements

### Motion Interpolation

I rebuilt a big part of the engine, so motion should look a lot smoother and cleaner now.

- Motion is locked to your screen's refresh, so clock jitter no longer shows up as uneven motion.
- Object edges no longer get blocky halos, and fine details like rails and skin stay sharp.
- Fast, small objects are tracked much better instead of ghosting.
- The background next to a fast-moving object keeps its own motion instead of getting dragged into blocky patches.
- Scene cuts are caught much better, even between similar shots, while water, fades, and fast pans aren't mistaken for cuts.
- Fades, flashes, water, chaotic action, and other parts that can't be tracked now blend smoothly instead of tearing or warping.
- Motion estimation is prepared ahead of time, so slower GPUs no longer hitch once per frame.
- The render pass is lighter on weak GPUs.
- When your GPU can't keep up, the in-between frames drop to 75% and then 60% resolution, while the real frames stay at full resolution. It goes back up once there's room, works with every quality level, and **Playback stats** shows the lower resolution while it's active.
- **Artifact protection** and **Scene-cut sensitivity** were removed from settings because the engine now handles both on its own.

---

## Other Changes

- Bumped the Lucky engine from `1.0.0` to `1.0.1`.
- The store listings now mention background play, the mini-player, Audio only, volume boost, Skip intro and credits, Open with Lucky, and the long-press video actions.

---

## Dependency Updates

- Bumped Android Gradle Plugin from `9.5.1` to `9.5.3`.
- Bumped Gradle from `9.9.1` to `9.9.2`.
- Bumped Compose BOM from `2026.09.00` to `2026.11.01`.
